name: openarc
description: A private evidence and investigation workspace for economic agents on Arc.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @openarc/shared build && pnpm --filter @openarc/db build && pnpm --parallel --filter @openarc/api --filter @openarc/web dev
scripts.e2e: pnpm --filter @openarc/shared build && playwright test && playwright test -c playwright.flag-off.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.api-boundary.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.arc-observation.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.agent-registry.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.job-evidence.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.gateway-evidence.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.local-agent-import.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.investigations.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.investigations.flag-off.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.policy-management.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.commerce-sessions.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.market-public.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.listing-management.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.machine-management.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.tenant-write.config.ts && pnpm e2e:tenant && playwright test -c playwright.supplied.config.ts
scripts.e2e:accounts: pnpm --filter @openarc/shared build && pnpm --filter @openarc/db build && playwright test -c playwright.account.config.ts
scripts.e2e:commerce-payment: pnpm --filter @openarc/shared build && pnpm --filter @openarc/db build && pnpm --filter @openarc/x402 build && pnpm --filter @openarc/api build && pnpm --filter @openarc/agent-harness build && playwright test -c playwright.commerce-payment.config.ts
scripts.release:gate: pnpm release:check && pnpm audit:prod && pnpm licenses:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:reference-contract && pnpm e2e
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @openarc/shared build && pnpm --filter @openarc/db build && pnpm --filter @openarc/x402 build && pnpm -r --if-present test --maxWorkers=2
